title: Silken Tofu Chocolate Mousse (Rich, Creamy & Vegan!)
byline: Sam Turnbull @ It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
ldName: Silken Tofu Chocolate Mousse (Rich, Creamy & Vegan!)
ldKeywords: chocolate, dairy free, dessert, mousse, no bake, protein, silken tofu, tofu, vegan
ldIngredientsRaw: 1/4 teaspoon instant espresso powder ((optional to enhance chocolate flavor))
ldInstructionsRaw: Melt the chocolate: Melt the chocolate gently in the microwave (in 20–30 second bursts, stirring between) or over a double boiler. Let it cool slightly so it’s warm but not hot.

Blend until silky: Add the silken tofu, melted chocolate, 2 tablespoons maple syrup, vanilla, salt, and espresso powder (if using) to a blender, food processor, or the cup of an immersion blender. Blend until completely smooth, scraping down the sides as needed. Taste and add 1 more tablespoon of maple syrup if you want it sweeter.
Chill (optional): Spoon into ramekins or small serving dishes. Chill for at least 1 hour for a thicker mousse texture. Or enjoy right away for a softer, pudding-like texture.
Serve: Serve chilled, plain or with your favorite toppings (see notes for ideas).
htmlIngredientLines: ▢ ¼ teaspoon instant espresso powder, (optional to enhance chocolate flavor)
